commits.subject: C4 F4: penalize observable post-move close calls in layer reward

scope: F4 observable safety-aware cooperation-layer reward and CPU tests only

registration.weight_units: reward-seconds per observed pair-event per 1-second control tick
registration.provenance: MAIN 2026-11-05 15:15 F4; implementation unit-weight registration fixed before tests, no outcome fitting or tuning; the task did not specify a numerical weight
registration.attribution: Measurement strictly after the first recorded nonzero library offset for the acting CAV in a currently active accepted move; through exclusive commitment expiry; episode-local history
registration.event_definition: Adjacent same-lane closing follower/leader pair using bumper gap and measured speeds from one authorized atomic sensor packet; deduplicated per acting CAV per tick

api.neighbourhood_reward: Existing API plus optional first_actuation_s; adds close_call evidence and close_call_penalty
api.training_episodes: Automatically derives move exposure from recorded active commitments and offsets; adds safety cost to cooperation-only episode copies
api.reward_update: Existing production envelope with per-row close_call evidence; A bypasses B/R registration and episode inspection
api.production_trainer: Validates F4 registration, attribution, observable IDs, timestamps, TTC/count/penalty arithmetic and augmented reward before existing full-rollout returns and PPO
api.config: Fixed common implementation registration is additive to the existing neighbour-weight registration; no arm-specific settings or tuning switch

tests.skip_reason: Existing Windows file-symlink privilege check; no remote qualification was run

tests.note: Final focused suite includes the additional delayed safety-cost-to-originating-trigger credit test

integration_notes: The existing production launch already invokes reward_update and the trainer; no new dispatch hook is needed
Identify the amended continuation recipe with the implementation commit and F4 registration; the original CLEAN1 objective did not contain this term
limitations: Post-move attribution is temporal and does not establish a move-versus-none causal effect
Only observed pairs count; terminal CAV exits preserve the existing measured-zero rule and do not fabricate missing pair coverage
Aggregate event counts sum local per-CAV exposures, whereas aggregate reward penalties use the existing equal-acting-CAV mean per step
